messages:
nina-sales: acme demo failing — SSE stream drops mid-response, frontend shows 'Unexpected end of JSON input'. Call in 20m. anyone available?

raj-eng: quick ask: which ingress? nginx or cloud lb? common cause is idle LB timeout or nginx buffering.

nina-sales: nginx-ingress (k8s) behind GCP LB. headers: Accept: text/event-stream, Transfer-Encoding: chunked.

anya-sre: quick triage steps:
- enable SSE keepalives (send `: keepalive\n\n` every 10s)
- set `proxy_buffering off; proxy_read_timeout 3600s` in ingress config
- check nginx error.log for `upstream prematurely closed connection`

raj-eng: runtime note: we saw a few `Killed signal 9` OOMs during spikes — that will truncate output. can runtime emit a final SSE error event on abort?

ops-bot: Alert: 2026-02-16T09:05:12Z  edge returned 502 for request r_ab12. 5m window: 8x502, 12x429.

nina-sales: acme also asks about POC concurrency and short-term dedicated pricing for 150 concurrent streams. who can advise?

anya-sre: for immediate relief, we can enable keepalives + increase LB idle timeout. for higher concurrency we need a short boost or dedicated mini-pool; sales ops can provide pricing.

raj-eng: repro command for team:
`curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams/generate`
watch for `data:` lines then abrupt EOF.

nina-sales: thanks — I'll collect nginx logs + client console screenshot and loop in sales ops for pricing. tagging @raj-eng and @anya-sre for the call.
